dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply falcate trailing edge characterized by a concave spline curve that steepens significantly at the lower third towards the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius, forming a smooth transition between the leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderate angular steepness approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the visible horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Height-to-width ratio is approximately 1.1:1, indicating a vertical height slightly greater than the visible base width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A primary deep, sharp-angled V-shaped notch is visible on the lower trailing edge; secondary smaller nicks and irregularities are present along the upper trailing margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Irregular pale mottling and superficial light-toned markings are visible on the posterior-lateral surface of the fin base.
